content.title: RULES EVERY WOMAN OVER 40 SHOULD START FOLLOWING NOW
facts: **Lift something heavy** twice a week to fight the muscle loss that quietly speeds up after 40.
**Prioritize protein** at breakfast, aim for 25-30g, to keep hunger and cravings in check all day.
**Get morning sunlight** within an hour of waking to steady your hormones and sleep quality.
**Check your posture** every hour if you sit at a desk, since hip and back stiffness creeps in fast at this stage.
**Cut back on late caffeine** after 2pm, your body clears it slower now and it wrecks deep sleep.
**Add a fiber-rich food** like lentils or berries to lunch daily to support hormone clearance and steady blood sugar.
**Schedule a bone density check** in your 40s, not your 60s, so you can act while there's still time to change course.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
If you're a woman over 40, small shifts matter more than ever. Take protein first: getting 25-30g at breakfast isn't just about muscle, it also blunts the blood sugar swings that get more common with age-related insulin resistance. Fiber works alongside it, foods like lentils and berries bind to excess estrogen in the gut so your body can clear it out instead of recirculating it, which matters as hormones start shifting. And morning sunlight isn't just a mood boost, it helps anchor your circadian rhythm so melatonin production later that night actually works the way it should. Everyone's body is different, so listen to yours and adjust from there.
